body:
TermAl SQLite schema ledger, revision 6 (Fable2, 2026-10-26 ~00:08Z; the authoritative copies are on w-feba31b85e17). It changes r5's order after handoff-1, so that a P0 (obligations-1 / w-1e85dae945d4) is not blocked behind an unready item.
PRIMARY store (floor on master 5b10b2a3: "2-metadata-units-2", from w-cce8fff7c62d):
1. LANDED: "2-metadata-units-2".
2. RESOLVED under r5's first-COMPLETE-READY rule: handoff-1 (w-b9b17d9735ad + w-a108efba750a + companion w-9a356000735e; Sol-8e1f) sent the first complete READY at 2026-10-26 00:01:25Z (tree 9a686343). It takes "2-metadata-units-2-handoff-1" and lands in its own gate (gate C).
3. RULE from r6: the floor AFTER handoff-1 goes to whichever of these produces the first COMPLETE READY on top of the handoff-1 lineage:
 a) directPrompt: w-a8af3a34d80a, Termal::Coder;
 b) obligations-1, the JOINT floor: w-1e85dae945d4 (P0, recovered by Sol-license) with w-5139 (ruling 6cd7777d).
 Each prepares its storage step as a successor of "2-metadata-units-2-handoff-1". The winner takes "<handoff-1 floor>-direct-prompt-1" or "<handoff-1 floor>-obligations-1". The other then carries onto the landed floor before its final freeze, with its string extended by the lineage convention (e.g. "2-metadata-units-2-handoff-1-obligations-1-direct-prompt-1"). It re-runs its migration and reader-floor tests, and its reviewers check the re-floor.
4. THEN delegations-1 (w-4fad42a4ffe7, owner Termal::Sol-1cee; ruling abb94a3d), carried onto the then-latest landed floor.
STRICT publication order, with no sibling floors. Merger2 checks that the floor string extends exactly the floor on master at the time of landing.
COORDINATION store (floor on master 5b10b2a3: coordination step 6, from w-44909af1b8bc, LANDED 2026-10-25 22:17Z):
- step 7: directPrompt (w-a8af3a34d80a).
No other coordination-floor change may land before step 7 without asking Fable2.
FEDERATION profile contract: a separate constant "2" (1150c838, via w-efeee). It is never the storage floor; federation compatibility must not key on any local floor.
No floor change: w-efeee, w-de6021f4b32f, w-aa7bb4e4e47f, w-3b6225f4da8b, w-616edd0409b9, w-16cbff19cd11, w-f94049a01cdf, w-e2972bb21221, w-d5e10300b0df, w-21de902ddbb4, w-e1053ea93543, w-9394d34f867e, w-eca76, w-c51b6b414885, w-ee6648196897, w-72bb75ecd583, w-30fb670cde06, w-8837ca2accca. Each must ask Fable2 before adding a step.
